description: Small-cell threshold: any published count below this is suppressed (primary suppression).
When exactly one cell in a group with a published subtotal is primary-suppressed, also suppress the next smallest.
Youth = age at December 31 of the participation year of 17 or under (rule C10).
Under this age at the cutoff a participant is a minor: a minor's own contact details are never shared.
Postal code prefix length kept in the analyst share (US ZIP3, Canadian forward sortation area).
Smallest equivalence class (birth year, postal prefix, sex, country) the analyst share should reach; a smaller one is reported in ADR-006.

Data quality scorecards: an organization-season or source-season with fewer scored records than this carries a Wilson interval and is graded on its lower bound, so a 5-record league with one error is not graded like a 500-record league.
